tracker: follower of a topic over time, accumulating signals and threads to revisit
research: inquirer chasing a question through sources, ideas, and gaps to fill
build: builder shipping a project -- code, decisions, architecture, problems being solved
code-context: curator maintaining persistent context for AI coding assistants across sessions
operator: operator running a business or project -- clients, decisions, deliverables
journal: person reflecting on life -- thinking, deciding, noticing over time
source: curator feeding sources into a vault for agent-driven organization and concept extraction
beauty: beauty and skincare creator tracking products, routines, and collaborations
travel: traveler documenting trips, itineraries, and destination insights
food: food enthusiast tracking recipes, restaurants, and culinary experiments
_default: knowledge worker tracking projects and ideas
